kashika: डत्यन्ता च या संख्या सा षट्संज्ञा भवति। कति तिष्ठन्ति। कति पश्य॥
kashikaEnglish: Words ending in डति are also called षट्.
englishShort: The word ending in the डति प्रत्यय which is referred to as 'संख्या' is also called 'षट्'.
englishFull:
Words ending in the affix डति are also called षट्.

By @ref[1.1.23], डति-words are already संख्या. This sūtra adds they're also षट्.

**Effect:** कति पठन्ति "how many read" — कति loses its plural ending by @ref[7.1.22].
